title: Web Developer
teaser: Web Developer specializing in Next.js for Graman's Group IT Department.
description_html:
About the role

Graman's Group is seeking a skilled Web Developer specializing in Next.js to join our IT Department. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and maintaining modern web applications using Next.js framework and related technologies. This is a probationary position with opportunities for regularization based on performance.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain responsive web applications using Next.js, React, and modern JavaScript frameworks

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including designers, product managers, and backend developers to deliver high-quality web solutions

  • Implement and optimize front-end architecture, ensuring application performance, scalability, and security

  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following industry best practices and coding standards

  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve technical issues across different browsers and devices

  • Participate in code reviews, testing procedures, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance development processes

  • Handle the full lifecycle: Git workflows, deployments (Vercel), environment setup

  • Build automation workflows (n8n) connecting APIs, LLMs, and internal tools

About you

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field

  • Minimum 2 years of professional experience in web development with at least 1 year working with Next.js framework

  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, HTML5, CSS3, and responsive design principles

  • Experience with RESTful APIs, Git version control, and modern development tools

  • Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work both independently and collaboratively

  • Strong communication skills in English and Filipino, with ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

  • Experience building and improving web apps using Next.js (React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Supabase/Postgres)

  • Experience using AI tools to support development workflow, such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and other AI tools

title: Junior Web and SQL Developer
teaser: To collaborate with key personnel and to oversee the performance of applications to ensure they are always aligned with the organizational goals.
description_html:
JR. WEB AND SQL DEVELOPER


JOB SUMMARY:

The Jr. Web and SQL Developer is responsible for building, maintaining and enhancing responsive web-based applications and relational databases to provide technology-based solutions for business problems across the organization. Leveraging core web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and web frameworks) alongside relational database management systems, this role focuses heavily on developing user-friendly front-end interfaces, writing and optimizing efficient SQL queries for data retrieval and reporting, and ensuring overall application performance. Working under the guidance of the I.T. Manager and collaborating closely with senior developers and cross-functional teams, this position supports backend integration, troubleshoots and debugs web applications, participates in quality assurance testing, manages version control using Git, and maintains detailed technical documentation to prevent knowledge silos and support ongoing IT initiatives.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. Web Development: Build and maintain front-end components using HTML, CSS, and Javascript, ensuring a responsive and user-friendly interface.
2. SQL Database Management: Develop and optimize SQL queries to ensure efficient data retrieval and manipulation.

3. Application Support: Provide support in troubleshooting and debugging web applications, collaborating with senior developers as needed.

4. Quality Assurance: Participate in testing web applications and database systems to ensure they meet functional and performance standars.

5. Technical Documentation: Contribute to creating and maintaining documentation, including code comments and user guides.

6. Collaboration: Work closely with other team members to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

7. Continuous Learning: Engage in learning activities tom improve technical skills and stay updated with industry trends.

8. Version Control: Use version control systems like Git to manage and document code changes.

9. Backend Development Support: Assist in backend development tasks, including server set up and database integration.

10. Data Reporting: Support the creation of data reports and visualizations based on SQL queries.


QUALIFICATIONS:

· Candidate must be a graduate of Bachelor’s/College Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.

· With good scholastic records and possesses good communication skills.

· With at least one (1) year experience in web development and SQL Database.

. At least created a web site and/or web pages either published online or base on portfolio project.


BENEFITS:

We give our employees compensation package:

· Basic Salary and meal allowance

·13th, 14th and 15th month bonuses

· HMO, Group Life & Accident Insurance

· Dental - Optical Allowance

· Medicine Assistance

· Career development


QUALIFIED APPLICANTS WILL RECEIVE AN SMS INVITE.
Office location is:

THE CATHAY DRUG COMPANY, INC.

2F Vernida 1 Condominium, 120 Amorsolo St., Legazpi Village, Makati City.

Please come in corporate attire and bring updated resume, original TOR and diploma.

title: Junior Web Developer
teaser: Junior Web Developer responsible for developing and maintaining websites and e-commerce platforms.
description_html:
About the role

The Junior Web Developer is responsible for developing, maintaining, and improving company websites and e-commerce platforms. The role requires knowledge of various web development technologies, content management systems, and e-commerce tools to ensure website functionality, performance, security, and user experience.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and update websites using WordPress and other web development technologies.

  • Customize WordPress themes and plugins using PHP, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and AJAX.

  • Build and modify website layouts using Elementor.

  • Manage and maintain e-commerce websites using WooCommerce and Shopify.

  • Update product listings, pricing, product descriptions, and other online store content.

  • Assist in integrating and maintaining payment gateways, including PayMongo.

  • Troubleshoot website errors, bugs, and technical issues.

  • Ensure website responsiveness, compatibility across browsers, and optimal performance.

  • Implement website enhancements based on business and user requirements.

  • Perform regular website maintenance, updates, and basic security checks.

About you

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  • Knowledgeable in WordPress, PHP, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and AJAX.

  • Familiarity with Elementor for website design and customization.

  • Knowledge or experience in WooCommerce and Shopify for e-commerce website management.

  • Basic understanding of website hosting, domain management, databases, and API integration.

  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Detail-oriented, adaptable, and willing to learn new technologies.

  • Fresh graduates with relevant technical knowledge or project experience are welcome to apply.

title: Junior Full-Stack Developer (AI-First) [initial 6 month contract]
teaser: Join our R&D team as a Junior Full Stack Developer to support Centro platform development.
bulletPoints: Work within a global software group operating in 60+ countries
Opportunity to work on exciting projects and collaborate with innovative minds.
A supportive team environment with opportunities for growth and development.
description_html:
About Centro ASSIST

Centro ASSIST delivers quality management and knowledge management software for community focused organisations across NDIS, Aged Care, Department of Veteran Affairs and Local Government.

We are a tight knit, passionate team who are willing to put in the hard yards, celebrate wins, and learn together. Our software grows with our customers, supporting them to remain compliant through tools that manage audits, policies and procedures, staff knowledge and competency, incident management, risk management and more.

Centro ASSIST is part of Volaris Group, a global family of vertical market software businesses focused on long-term growth, customer value and operational excellence.

The Opportunity

We are looking for two Junior Full Stack Developers to join our Research and Development team. In these roles, you will support the ongoing development of the Centro platform by delivering small enhancements, resolving bugs, and improving stability and performance as we continue our Centro 2.0 roadmap. This includes contributing to AI development initiatives and AI-enabled features where required.

The ideal candidates have hands-on experience building web applications across the front end and back end, enjoy problem solving, and are comfortable working in a remote team. You will be mentored by our Engineering Lead and will be expected to take ownership of well-scoped tasks and see them through to release. You’ll also learn and apply AI‑assisted development practices safely (e.g., drafting tests/documentation and exploring implementation options), while validating outputs through testing and code review.

This role will initially be offered as a six-month fixed-term contract. Subject to business growth, ongoing requirements, individual performance and the outcome of the end-of-contract review, there may be an opportunity to extend the contract or transition to a permanent full-time position.

Key responsibilities

  • Use AI-assisted software development tools responsibly to improve productivity and quality on assigned work (e.g. generating test ideas, drafting documentation, summarising logs and exploring implementation options), and validate outputs through testing and code review before release.

  • Build and enhance features across the Centro platform (front end, back end and APIs).

  • Assist with the delivery of Centro 2.0 initiatives and funded enhancements (e.g. the Customer Register and related compliance tools).

  • Troubleshoot, debug and resolve defects; contribute to reducing support tickets through root-cause fixes.

  • Write clean, maintainable code and follow agreed engineering practices, including Git workflows, code reviews and documentation.

  • Contribute to testing (unit and integration), UAT support and regression testing for releases.

  • Collaborate with Product and Support to prioritise work and communicate progress, risks and blockers.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience building web applications across the front end and back end (professional experience or a strong portfolio).

  • Demonstrated ability to use AI-assisted development tools responsibly, validate outputs through testing and code review, and protect confidential or sensitive information.

  • Working knowledge of modern JavaScript or TypeScript and a front-end framework (e.g. Angular, React or Vue).

  • Experience with server-side development (e.g. .NET, Node.js or similar) and building or consuming APIs.

  • Comfortable with relational databases and SQL.

  • Familiarity with Git workflows and participation in code reviews.

  • A quality mindset: testing, debugging and attention to detail.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a remote team.

Desirable:

  • Experience working with Angular 22, .NET10, Postgres 18 

  • Experience with CI/CD (e.g., Gitlab CI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Azure DevOps) and/or cloud platforms (Azure preferred). 

  • Experience writing automated tests (unit/integration/e2e) using Playwright or others. 

  • Experience working with regulated industries (NDIS, aged care, healthcare) or compliance tooling. 

  • Experience working with telemetric tools and agentic recovery processes. 

  • Experience creating native mobile applications 

Why join Centro ASSIST

We are all about finding the right people for the right roles and giving them the opportunity to directly contribute to the success of our organisation. Our employees are experts in their field, passionate about what they do, and always looking for new and better ways to solve our industry’s problems.

We offer competitive remuneration, a comprehensive benefits package and the opportunity to learn from the best in the business.

Your next step:

If you’re interested in joining Centro ASSIST, please send your resume and a brief cover letter, along with any portfolio or GitHub links via the "Quick Apply” button.

title: Intermediate Web Developer | Onsite - Ortigas | PH
teaser: If you enjoy building useful applications, improving existing systems, and using modern development tools to work smarter, we'd love to meet you.
description_html:
Set-up and Location: ONSITE - Ortigas, Pasig City
Work Schedule: 6:00 AM to 3:00 PM
Employment Type: Full-time

Build Practical Solutions. Write Smarter Code. Make an Impact.

The Intermediate Web Developer will build, improve, and maintain internal web applications that support our business operations. You'll work across the full development lifecycle, from database design and backend services to frontend interfaces, turning business requirements into functional, reliable software.

This isn't just a role where you'll be handed a list of tickets and expected to code. You'll work directly with internal teams to understand their processes, identify problems worth solving, and develop practical solutions that make everyday work easier and more efficient.

We also embrace AI-powered development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, and GitHub Copilot to accelerate software development. You don't need to write every line of code from scratch, but you must understand the code you're working with, validate AI-generated output, troubleshoot issues, and take responsibility for the quality of what you deliver.

We're looking for someone with strong development fundamentals, a practical problem-solving mindset, and the confidence to figure things out independently. If you enjoy building useful applications, improving existing systems, and using modern development tools to work smarter, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Do
You'll be the kind of person who:

Full-Stack Application Development
  • Build, enhance, and maintain internal web applications across the database, backend, and frontend layers.
  • Develop responsive and user-friendly interfaces using React or other modern frontend frameworks.
  • Build backend services and application logic using Node.js, Express, NestJS, or similar frameworks.
  • Translate business requirements into functional software that addresses real operational needs.
  • Improve existing features and contribute to the ongoing development of our internal platform.
AI-Assisted Development
  • Use AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot to accelerate development and improve productivity.
  • Review, understand, test, and validate AI-generated code before incorporating it into applications.
  • Identify incorrect assumptions, potential bugs, security concerns, and inefficient implementations in generated code.
  • Use AI tools to support debugging, code improvement, documentation, and technical problem-solving.
  • Apply sound engineering judgement to ensure that development speed does not compromise code quality, reliability, or maintainability.
Backend Development & API Integration
  • Develop and maintain backend services, application logic, and REST APIs.
  • Integrate external platforms, APIs, and third-party services into internal applications.
  • Implement appropriate error handling, data validation, and integration logic to ensure reliable application behaviour.
  • Troubleshoot API issues and resolve problems involving data exchange between systems.
  • Contribute to the design and maintenance of reusable backend components and services.
Database Management & Development
  • Work with PostgreSQL and other structured databases to design and maintain data structures.
  • Write, optimise, and troubleshoot SQL queries to support application functionality and reporting requirements.
  • Manage database changes, including schema updates and data migrations.
  • Ensure data integrity, consistency, and appropriate handling of application data.
  • Identify and address database-related performance issues as applications evolve.
Debugging, Testing & Code Quality
  • Investigate and resolve bugs, technical issues, and unexpected application behaviour.
  • Improve existing code to enhance readability, maintainability, performance, and reliability.
  • Test features and validate changes before deployment to minimise disruptions.
  • Document important technical decisions, implementation details, and troubleshooting procedures.
  • Collaborate with other developers through Git, version control, and code reviews.
  • Help maintain consistent development standards and best practices across the internal platform.
Stakeholder Collaboration & Continuous Improvement
  • Work directly with internal teams to understand business processes, pain points, and technical requirements.
  • Translate operational challenges into practical software solutions.
  • Communicate technical concepts and implementation considerations clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to improve existing applications, automate manual tasks, and streamline workflows.
  • Take ownership of assigned deliverables from initial requirements through development, testing, and ongoing improvement.

What You Bring
We're looking for someone with:

  • At least 2 years of experience in software development, preferably building and maintaining web applications.
  • Strong JavaScript or TypeScript programming skills.
  • Experience building backend services using Node.js, Express, NestJS, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience developing frontend applications using React or another modern frontend framework.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases, with experience using other structured databases also considered.
  • Experience consuming REST APIs and integrating external platforms or services.
  • Familiarity with Git, version control, and working with existing codebases.
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or GitHub Copilot.
  • Ability to review and validate AI-generated code rather than relying on generated output without understanding it.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot issues independently.
  • Ability to take ownership of technical deliverables and follow through on implementation.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Willingness to learn new technologies, explore unfamiliar codebases, and adapt to evolving development requirements.

You don't need to know every technology in our stack. We value strong engineering fundamentals, practical problem-solving, sound technical judgement, and the ability to learn quickly. What matters most is your ability to build working software, understand the code you ship, and take responsibility for the solutions you deliver.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building internal tools, dashboards, CRMs, or other business applications.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Docker, authentication, and role-based access control.
  • Familiarity with automated testing, continuous integration, and continuous deployment (CI/CD).
  • Experience deploying and maintaining applications on cloud platforms.
  • Experience integrating business systems such as HubSpot, Zoho, or Microsoft 365.
  • Familiarity with application security, performance optimisation, and software development best practices.
Why You'll Love Working Here
  • Competitive compensation package.
  • HMO, Dental, and Life Insurance for you and one free dependent from day one, with the option to enroll additional dependents.
  • Paid Leaves: Birthday, Vacation, Medical, and Maternity. Up to 6 Vacation Leaves are convertible to cash on your anniversary.
  • Employee Engagement Activities: Year-End Party, Family Day, Team Building, and more!
Let's Talk


If you're thinking, "I love building useful things, solving problems, and using technology to make work better," this could be your next move.

Click apply. We can't wait to meet you.

Experience developing frontend applications using React or another modern frontend framework. Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases, with experience using other structured databases also considered. Experience consuming REST APIs and integrating external platforms or services. Familiarity with Git, version control, and working with existing codebases. Hands-on experience using AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or GitHub Copilot. Ability to review and validate AI-generated code rather than relying on generated output without understanding it. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot issues independently. Ability to take ownership of technical deliverables and follow through on implementation. Good written and verbal communication skills in English. Willingness to learn new technologies, explore unfamiliar codebases, and adapt to evolving development requirements. You don't need to know every technology in our stack. We value strong engineering fundamentals, practical problem-solving, sound technical judgement, and the ability to learn quickly. What matters most is your ability to build working software, understand the code you ship, and take responsibility for the solutions you deliver. Nice to Have Experience building internal tools, dashboards, CRMs, or other business applications. Experience with PostgreSQL, Docker, authentication, and role-based access control. Familiarity with automated testing, continuous integration, and continuous deployment (CI/CD). Experience deploying and maintaining applications on cloud platforms. Experience integrating business systems such as HubSpot, Zoho, or Microsoft 365. Familiarity with application security, performance optimisation, and software development best practices. Why You'll Love Working Here Competitive compensation package. HMO, Dental, and Life Insurance for you and one free dependent from day one, with the option to enroll additional dependents. Paid Leaves: Birthday, Vacation, Medical, and Maternity. Up to 6 Vacation Leaves are convertible to cash on your anniversary. Employee Engagement Activities: Year-End Party, Family Day, Team Building, and more! Let's Talk If you're thinking, "I love building useful things, solving problems, and using technology to make work better," this could be your next move. Click apply. We can't wait to meet you.

title: Web Developer
teaser: Supporting Windows-based applications and databases. Requires 4+ years in application development, SQL, APIs, and troubleshooting.
description_html:
Schedule: Mid Shift / Nightshift Rotation

Setup: Hybrid


The Application Support Engineer is responsible for maintaining the stability, availability, security, and performance of the AIMS Warehouse Management System, a Tier 1 business-critical application supporting more than 50 medical distribution centers across the United States and Canada. The role provides technical leadership for application support, infrastructure maintenance, incident resolution, system upgrades, disaster recovery testing, and continuous service improvement.

The position operates within a 24x7 support model and works closely with infrastructure, database, networking, SAP, middleware, cybersecurity, and third-party vendor teams to ensure uninterrupted business operations.


Required Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of experience in application development.

  • Bachelor's degree in related field, or equivalent work experience, preferred

  • Experience supporting Windows Server environments.

  • Experience with SQL queries, troubleshooting, and basic performance analysis.

  • Understanding of web application architecture and client/server environments.

  • Familiarity with REST APIs, SOAP Services, HTTPS protocols, JSON, and XML.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with DTS, SSIS, and SSRS.

  • Understanding of database support and maintenance concepts.

  • Familiarity with applications hosted on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

  • Exposure to scripting and automation using PowerShell or Perl.

  • Understanding of enterprise application integrations and APIs.

  • Basic knowledge of DevSecOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Familiarity with Jenkins.

  • Experience using monitoring tools such as Dynatrace and BigPanda.

  • Experience or familiarity with ServiceNow, ITIL Framework, SailPoint, and CyberArk.

Key Responsibilities

Application Maintenance & Support

  • Provide production support through a rotating three-shift support model.

  • Monitor application health, system alerts, batch processes, and performance indicators.

  • Investigate and resolve application incidents and service requests using ServiceNow.

  • Troubleshoot application, database, infrastructure, and integration-related issues and escalate complex problems to appropriate technical teams.

  • Support application version upgrades, patches, and scheduled maintenance activities.

  • Maintain clear incident resolution notes and technical documentation.

Infrastructure & Platform Support

  • Assist with server maintenance activities, including operating system upgrades, security patching, and certificate renewals.

  • Support Windows-based application and database environments.

  • Work with infrastructure teams to resolve platform availability and security-related issues.

Database & Performance Support

  • Perform SQL queries and basic database troubleshooting.

  • Assist in identifying application and database performance issues.

  • Support SQL Server maintenance activities and coordinate more complex issues with database support teams.

Incident & Problem Management

  • Respond to production incidents and participate in SRT activities.

  • Engage appropriate support groups including Network, Database, Server Infrastructure, SAP, Integration Platforms, third-party vendors, and application SMEs.

  • Assist with root cause analysis and implementation of corrective actions for recurring incidents.

  • Track issues through resolution and provide appropriate status updates.

Change & Release Management

  • Support application maintenance, upgrade, and deployment activities.

  • Participate in release testing, validation, and implementation.

  • Follow established change management and deployment processes.

  • Coordinate with team members and supporting groups during production changes.

Compliance, Documentation & Resiliency

  • Support SOX compliance and audit-related activities.

  • Participate in annual Disaster Recovery (DR) testing activities.

  • Create and maintain support procedures, technical documentation, knowledge articles, and operational runbooks.

  • Participate in knowledge-sharing and cross-training activities to strengthen overall team support capability.

title: Web Developer (Fresh Graduates are welcome to apply!)
teaser: Web Development Intern opportunity for fresh graduates to learn hands-on web development.
description_html:
Fresh Graduates Welcome | HTML | CSS | JavaScript | PHP | MySQL

Looking for a place to actually start building your skills as a web developer?

We’re looking for a Web Development Intern who wants hands-on experience learning how web applications are built.

This opportunity is open to both students completing their internship and fresh graduates looking for their first development experience.

You don’t need to know the entire tech stack yet. You’ll go through a structured training program covering:

HTML • CSS • JavaScript • MySQL • PHP • CodeIgniter • Laravel

You’ll learn through training videos, coding exercises and hands-on practice before applying what you’ve learned to a small web project under supervision.


What you’ll do

  • Complete structured web development training and coding exercises

  • Build practice pages and sample features in a sandbox environment

  • Learn and follow coding standards and development guidelines

  • Document your progress and learnings

  • Communicate questions or blockers clearly

  • Build a small web project at the end of the program

Your final project may include an external landing page, middleware page or simple non-production internal tool.


Who we’re looking for

You may be a good fit if you are:

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in IT, Computer Science or a related field

  • A fresh graduate looking to start a career in web development

  • Familiar with basic computer and web concepts

  • Interested in learning front-end and back-end development

  • Comfortable following structured training and instructions

  • Open to feedback and willing to keep improving

No professional web development experience is required.

What matters more is your willingness to learn, discipline in completing the training and ability to work through problems.


What we want you to achieve

By the end of the internship, you should be able to:

  • Complete the assigned development training

  • Demonstrate understanding of the core technologies

  • Build a working small web application or page

  • Present your project and explain its logic and flow


You’ll be learning inside the technology team of a growing company working toward a bigger mission: helping make homeownership possible for more Filipinos.


If you’re looking for your first real step into web development, we’d like to hear from you.

title: Junior Software Engineer
teaser: Build real-world fintech solutions with Stay Finance! Work remotely, grow your coding skills, and make an impact with your projects.
description_html:
Junior Software Engineer / Junior Software Developer

Stay Finance | Work From Home | Philippines

About Stay Finance

Stay Finance is an Australian fintech company transforming how Australians access finance. We’re building and improving our digital lending platform to provide a simpler, faster, and more transparent customer experience.

We’re looking for a motivated Junior Software Engineer / Junior Software Developer to join our growing team. This is an opportunity for an early-career developer to contribute to real-world projects, take ownership of their work, and develop their technical skills while working remotely with an Australian-based team.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Assist in developing, maintaining, testing, monitoring, and improving our web applications and digital lending platform.

  • Build and update frontend features using React, Next.js, or other JavaScript frameworks.

  • Support backend development using Node.js and frameworks such as Express.js.

  • Work with databases such as MongoDB and PostgreSQL.

  • Develop, integrate, and maintain RESTful APIs.

  • Identify bugs, investigate issues, troubleshoot problems, and implement solutions.

  • Write clean, organised, and maintainable code.

  • Participate in code reviews and technical discussions.

  • Collaborate with the team to understand requirements and deliver practical solutions.

  • Document development work and communicate progress regularly.

About You

We’re looking for someone with a solid foundation in software development who can demonstrate practical coding ability, work independently, and take initiative when solving problems.

Essential Skills & Requirements

  • Git: Comfortable using Git for version control, including committing changes and working with branches.

  • JavaScript: Good understanding of JavaScript fundamentals.

  • TypeScript: Familiarity with TypeScript and its core concepts.

  • Frontend development: Experience with at least one JavaScript framework, preferably React and Next.js.

  • Backend development: Experience with Node.js and at least one Node.js framework, preferably Express.js.

  • Databases: Experience with MongoDB, PostgreSQL, or both. Strong experience with PostgreSQL alone is acceptable.

  • REST APIs: Understanding of RESTful API design, integration, and usage.

  • Practical projects: Must be able to demonstrate individual contributions through personal, freelance, internship, or professional software projects.

  • Problem-solving: Ability to investigate technical issues, research solutions, and troubleshoot independently.

  • Work ethic: Able to work independently, manage priorities, take ownership of tasks, and meet deadlines.

  • Communication: Good written and verbal English communication skills.

  • Remote work setup: Own reliable computer and work equipment, plus a stable internet connection.

Project Experience Requirement

Applicants must list at least one personal or professional software project they have worked on and explain their individual contributions.

University group projects may be included as additional experience, but group projects alone will not be sufficient. We need to understand what you have personally designed, developed, implemented, or maintained.

For each project, please provide:

  • Project name and a brief description.

  • Technologies and frameworks used.

  • Your specific responsibilities and individual contributions.

  • A GitHub repository, portfolio, live demo, or other relevant evidence, where available.

Candidates should be prepared to discuss their projects and explain their code during the recruitment process.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with AWS or other cloud platforms.

  • Experience using Docker or CI/CD pipelines.

  • Understanding of application security and software engineering best practices.

  • Experience working in Agile development environments.

  • Previous experience working with a BPO company or an overseas-based company, preferably collaborating with international teams.

Work Arrangement

  • Location: Work from home, Philippines

  • Employment type: Full-time

  • Working days: Monday to Friday

  • Working hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Australian time

  • Equipment: Applicants must have their own reliable computer and work equipment, as well as a stable internet connection.

Applicants must be available to work consistently during the required Australian business hours and communicate effectively with the team remotely.

Why Join Stay Finance?

  • Gain hands-on experience working on a real-world fintech platform.

  • Develop your skills across frontend and backend technologies.

  • Work on practical projects that support real business operations.

  • Take ownership of tasks and contribute ideas to improve our platform.

  • Grow your career in a developing Australian fintech company.

  • Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely from the Philippines.

Ready to Apply?

If you're passionate about software development and can demonstrate your technical skills through projects you've personally worked on, we'd love to hear from you.

Please submit your resume and include links to your GitHub profile, portfolio, or relevant software projects. Clearly explain your individual contributions to each project listed.
